scope: Offline diagnostic of saved Development results only; no raw acquisition, trait remeasurement or promotion
priorExposure: All fixed trait statuses and failure reasons viewed before this protocol; analysis is post hoc, not a new confirmatory trial
classification: Multi-label, evidence-qualified. CONFIRMED only for exact saved Gate evidence. INDICATION is not validation. NOT_ESTABLISHED is not false. UNKNOWN is not zero.
strata: Use saved liquidity tertiles only; no price/volatility strata results are available. No post-hoc threshold selection.
windows: 20/60/250 existing snapshots only. Summarize eligible counts, nEff, drift and descriptive correlations; overlapping snapshots cannot establish recent reliability.
peer: Use existing A-only peer fit; cross-sectional fit and shrinkage do not validate peer/cluster persistence. No new clusters.
sparse: Candidate research view includes only unchanged USABLE traits and eligible symbol/window cells. This is an availability view, not a per-symbol reliability certification or Gate replacement.
definitionAudit: Inspect implementations and exact registry contracts; synthetic counterexamples allowed. No threshold changes. No new registry until a confirmed scalar definition defect and separate precommit exist.
deterministic: All output JSON/CSV generated twice, byte-identical; source file hashes rechecked
stop: After diagnostic tests/regression/CI/evidence/handoff. New LONG Entry/EXIT redesign only in a subsequent stage if Dictionary and Reader are independently Development-usable.
